data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's stated claim is internally inconsistent and contradicts its own derivation. The claim asserts the 4th cut can produce a maximum of 7 pieces (with 7 if distinct), but the mechanism immediately computes that a distinct 4th concurrent line adds regions to the existing 6 from 3 cuts, yielding 10 (or, under its stricter interior-only count, 10) — never 7. It also lists a countercondition saying simultaneous cuts yield exactly 8, which is the standard concurrency result, while the claim's 'maximum 7' is lower than that, making the committed maximum false for four concurrent diameters.
